research_basis: Condensed operational structure synthesised from Hajer's UAE green-SME driver research, the Green SME Drivers survey, the finance-driven Fuzzy DEMATEL and TOPSIS paper, and the revised GreenSMECapt framework.

domains.title: Internal Factors
domains.description: Internal leadership, workforce, technical and digital readiness for green transition.

domains.title: Government & Institutional Support
domains.description: Regulatory requirements, standards and institutional implementation support.

domains.title: Market Conditions
domains.description: Customer, buyer, competitive and reputational conditions affecting green transition.

domains.title: Access to Finance
domains.description: Availability of green finance, grants and incentives supporting transition.

factors.title: Leadership & organizational commitment
factors.definition: Leadership ownership, strategic commitment, management systems and organisational follow-through for green transition.

factors.title: Workforce / technical capability & training
factors.definition: Employee engagement, technical competence, organisational learning and access to relevant training.

factors.title: Digital, data & AI readiness
factors.definition: Ability to adopt suitable technology and use digital monitoring, reliable data and AI-supported capabilities.

factors.title: Regulation, compliance & standards/certifications
factors.definition: Regulatory conditions and the SME's ability to satisfy legal, environmental, standards and certification requirements.

factors.title: Institutional support & implementation guidance
factors.definition: Government programmes, incentives, technology support, knowledge institutions and practical implementation guidance.

factors.title: Customer/buyer demand, competitiveness & reputation
factors.definition: Consumer demand, buyer and procurement requirements, competitive pressure, tender access and green reputation.

factors.title: Green finance availability, grants & incentives
factors.definition: Access to suitable green finance, grants, guarantees, incentives and impact or ESG-linked funding.
